content.text:
You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This module specifies a randomized-input variant of a spanning-tree construction algorithm over a graph whose node set is given by Nodes and whose root is Root. The graph edges are not declared as a constant; instead, Edges is defined using TLC's RandomElement to choose, for each node, a random subset of the other nodes, yielding a randomly generated undirected graph for model checking. The state consists of parent pointers mom and distance estimates dist, initialized so every node points to itself and only the root has distance 0; the Next action lets a node adopt a neighbor with a strictly smaller distance and choose an intermediate smaller distance value. The specification checks type correctness, a postcondition characterizing a rooted spanning-tree or unreachable nodes, a safety property stating that quiescence implies the postcondition, a liveness property that eventually the postcondition holds, and a fairness-based progress condition in Spec using WF_vars(Next).
